content: Tailwind v4 replaced the JS config file with a CSS-first @theme directive: theme variables are plain CSS custom properties that Tailwind reads to generate utility classes. Recommended dark-theme pattern: define raw color tokens in :root/.dark, map them into semantic names via @theme inline (e.g. --color-primary: var(--primary)), so components use bg-primary etc. and swapping .dark on <html> retheme instantly. Colors are now expressed in OKLCH by default (perceptually uniform, better for dark-mode contrast tuning) instead of HSL.
